name: unknown_delivery_fault_recovery
title: Unknown：真实 delivery-unknown 故障注入与恢复（工单 04 提供）
description: Wired to the merged work order 04 probe: the runner arms the one-shot DEBUG receipt-loss fault with --drop-next-delivery-receipt and runs --receipt-loss-probe through the production route. It still requires the signed DEBUG build, the controlled frontmost fixture page and real Accessibility/Screen Recording permissions, so a run is refused rather than guessed when the binary is stale or the capability flag is absent.
user_words: 点击右边的设置按钮（随后在同一任务中请求继续）

expectations.note: Checks encode work order 04's acceptance contract for scenario U so the integrator rerun is a single command.

prerequisites: Integration branch contains work orders 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 (merge order 01 → 02 → 04 → 03 → 05).
Rebuild the DEBUG Her.app in Xcode from the integration branch (the runner refuses a stale binary).
Fixture page open in frontmost Safari; Accessibility and Screen Recording granted.
